=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:1317 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `review_prepush_test_gate_final_ci_now_green` jq filter requires an older `ci/final` `failure` (`(length > 1) and ... and any(.[1:][]; .state == "failure")`) as well as a success newer than the hand-back marker, so its green check is stricter than the gate's rule in `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh` (newest `github-actions[bot]` `ci/final` is `success` and newer than the marker).
  WHY: When the history holds no older failure (for example success-then-success after a failed `failure` POST, or the failure record falls outside the 100 fetched statuses), the helper returns `not_green` and the repair commit is pushed over a head that is already green, which is the #9725 recurrence that G3 exists to prevent. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (confidence 2) because the history needs an unlikely sequence on one SHA. The other three reviewers rated it MAJOR (confidence 4, 5 and 4). The highest rating, MAJOR, is used here and mapped to high.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

(No task gaps reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:line 1317, the `--jq` filter `if (length > 1) and (.[0].state == "success") and (.[0].at > "<marker>") and any(.[1:][]; .state == "failure") then "green" ...` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The repair step's green check is stricter than the gate's `final_ci_now_green` rule. Now that the marker-time comparison already rejects a stale success, the older-failure requirement only turns a real post-marker success into `not_green`.
  WHY: On a success-then-success history, the helper returns `not_green` and the repair commit is pushed over a head the gate would call green. The reviewer downgraded this from the pass-1 high/MAJOR because the history needs three things on one SHA: an earlier passing final CI, a later failing re-run (`_pr_ensure_final_ci` does not re-dispatch after a completed success), and `scripts/ci_final_status.sh` (lines 107-117) failing to POST `failure` even after `gh_retry` retries.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, review_prepush_test_gate_final_ci_now_green, the `--jq` filter at line 1317. Remove `(length > 1) and` and `and any(.[1:][]; .state == "failure")`, update the two comment sentences, and change the `no_older_failure` test to expect `green`. Estimated 4 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:1317, condition any(.[1:][]; .state == "failure") | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pre-push check needs an older `ci/final` failure in the statuses history before it treats a head as green and skips, which is too strict.
  WHY: If the failure record is missing from the 100 fetched statuses (overwritten by newer statuses, or never posted), the helper returns `not_green` and goes ahead with an unnecessary repair commit even when the newest status is a success newer than the marker.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:1317, condition `any(.[1:]; .state == "failure")` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The pre-push green check needs an older `ci/final` failure in addition to a success newer than the hand-back marker. G3 only requires `ci/final` to be success on the approved head; it does not require the earlier failure to have been recorded.
  WHY: If the gate sees an older success from before the marker and selects the repair, and a newer success then appears after the marker but the failed attempt's status was never recorded, the condition returns `not_green` and the repair commit goes ahead although final CI is green.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:line 1317 (`review_prepush_test_gate_final_ci_now_green`), the clause `any(.[1:][]; .state == "failure")` in the jq filter | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The repair-step green check needs an older `ci/final` `failure`, while the gate's rule in scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh does not. Example history: success@11:00 (stale, left by a failed `ci/final=failure` POST, the history cited at lines 1295-1297), marker@12:00, then success@13:00. The helper returns `not_green` for it.
  WHY: The gate selects the repair (older_than_marker), the sweep's re-run turns the head green, and the re-check still returns `not_green`, so the repair commit replaces the green approved head: the #9725 recurrence. The gate and the repair step therefore disagree on this history. The clause adds nothing for the stale-success case, because the `success_older_than_marker` test at tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py:856-857 shows the marker-time check alone rejects it. No test covers `("success", "success")` newer than the marker.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh, line 1317, the jq filter in `review_prepush_test_gate_final_ci_now_green`. Drop `any(.[1:][]; .state == "failure")` so the condition matches the gate's rule. Add a `("success", "success")` case to `test_final_ci_repair_commits_when_final_ci_is_not_green` that asserts `outcome=skipped reason=final_ci_now_green`. Estimated 2 + ~4 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 4.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
